title: Goobers VR Modpack
description: Hey Goob's and Gabs and welcome to my VR Modpack for fabric Minecraft 26.1.2! My goal for this modpack is to keep things pretty vanilla, while giving you the most bang for your buck in VR!
body:
This mod adds many performance and quality of life mods to improve your daily gameplay inside of VR Minecraft (Vivecraft), especially to help prolonged game sessions, while keeping Minecraft as Vanilla as possible. Be sure to check out the Nvidium fork and the Sodium LOD Fixer if you need it!

**What This Modpack adds** (See the modpack version 1.0.0 to see a full list):
- Vivecraft (of course)
- Performance Mods like Sodium, Voxy, Culling Mods, and others to speed up your game! 
- Quality Of Life Mods like Shulker Box Tooltip, Reacharound, and perfect accuracy to speed up your efficiency while playing in VR
- VR specific mods like ImmersiveMC, VR Throwing Extensions, and VR Swing Sprint to help make Minecraft _feel_ like a VR Game

This is quite a small modpack, but that is on purpose! I didn't want to add any bloat which would increase the stress of getting this modpack updated, as well as the liklihood that things wouldn't work. Also, this modpack attempts to retain as many of Minecraft's vanilla mechanics as posssible. The only things that may not be very "vanilla" come from Reacharound and VR in general, but Reacharound's mechanic comes from Bedrock, and you wouldn't be here if not for the VR! Hope you enjoy!
